resources.string: Sunset lights city buildings as traffic passes beneath green signals.
Sunlit golden needles on lakeside branches, with shimmering water behind them.

string-array.name: ai_summary_preview_city_narrations
string-array.item: Green lights hurry you along; the sunset makes you want to linger.
The city clocks off as the sunset gilds the streets.
Traffic flows through dusk, and the whole street wears a golden glow.
The lights keep traffic moving; the sunset makes the street shine.
The sunset turns an ordinary road home into a movie scene.

string-array.name: ai_summary_preview_autumn_narrations
string-array.item: Autumn hangs gold on the branches and scatters diamonds across the water.
The branches dress in gold, and the water cannot help but sparkle.
A branch of autumn reaches toward the water, stirring a pool of shimmering light.
Sunlight leaves a little gold on the branches, then scatters stars across the water.
The branches keep autumn close; the water twinkles with its little secrets.
